candidate_binding.model_source: forbidden; registered reference source H5 only
candidate_binding.native_volume: linearly interpolated mass/density from current interval endpoints
candidate_binding.support: all current valid fluid rows within 2h after finite-wall visibility
candidate_binding.temporal_field: linear saved-field arrays; native particle trajectories not interpolated
candidate_binding.valid_fluid_native_rows: identical row mask required at every selected endpoint

source.endpoint_row_mask_check: performed lazily for the current interval pair; no future endpoint field is pre-read

source_definition.identity: independent geometric seeds; native particle_id never partitions or terminates a seed

wall_binding.geometry: F3 finite closed bottom,left,right,front,back; top open

checkpoint.generation_policy: content-addressed NPZ generations are never overwritten
checkpoint.ordering: HDF5 frame append and flush, immutable generation publish, then atomic manifest replace
checkpoint.resume_source_of_truth: last manifest generation; HDF5 is truncated to its committed frame

event_definition.first_passage: continuous crossing of x=0 into opposite source half on accepted linear RK segment
event_definition.residence: accepted segment time in the opposite source half
event_definition.return: first later crossing back to the seed's origin half

binding.frame_policy: linear interpolation of native position/velocity/mass/density arrays between exactly the two registered selected frames bracketing each current integration interval; no extrapolation
binding.material_reliability: not established by numerical support diagnostics
binding.model_source: forbidden; provider opens only registered reference source_h5

static_backend.native_particle_id: not used for query identity or termination
static_backend.temporal_field: linear interpolation of the two registered saved endpoint arrays, including support positions
static_backend.tracer_path: independent RK4 state; no native particle trajectory is used as a tracer path

binding.support_native_particle_positions: linearly interpolated between current interval endpoints
binding.tracer_path: independent RK4 state; not interpolated from native particle labels

summary.material_reliability: not established by numerical support diagnostics

source_window.native_frame_policy: selected native source frames are the only field endpoints; each accepted interval uses componentwise linear interpolation between its two endpoints
